import sqlite3

# Connect to the SQLite database
conn = sqlite3.connect('lever__posting_enhanced.db')
cursor = conn.cursor()

# Query the total sum of count_referred_applications
query = "SELECT SUM(count_referred_applications) FROM lever__posting_enhanced"
cursor.execute(query)
total_sum = cursor.fetchone()[0]

print(f"Total sum of count_referred_applications: {total_sum}")

# Close the connection
conn.close()

tables = cursor.fetchall()
